videos.title: Paying your dues
videos.about: Sam owes $275. He pays $250 by card, gets a receipt with a confirmation number, and sees his balance and history update before he leaves the page.

videos.title: Setting up AutoPay
videos.about: Sam clears the last $25 from his bank account, saves the account, and turns on AutoPay at $250 a month.

videos.title: Your gate and guest codes
videos.about: The codes for Sam's home stay hidden until he asks to see them, and he can ask for a new one from the same place.

videos.title: Setting a home's gate codes
videos.about: A board member sets the gate and guest codes for a home. The change is recorded, who and when, never the code itself.

videos.title: Your activity, and your home's timeline
videos.about: Two lists, kept apart on purpose: what names Sam, and what happened to his home, with the key updates on their own.

videos.title: The month, checked against NMI
videos.about: Every online payment this month set against what NMI reports: what agrees, what has not settled yet, and where the amounts differ.

videos.title: Closing the month
videos.about: Closing is offered, not required. It records who closed the month and what was still open, and it can be reopened.

videos.title: A refund takes two people
videos.about: The treasurer asks for a refund and confirms her password. She can't approve her own request. The president approves it, with her own password.

videos.title: The complete history
videos.about: Everything done in the community, who did it, and the before and after: filterable, exportable, and impossible to edit or delete.

videos.title: Bringing a community in, from a spreadsheet
videos.about: A new community is set up from an Excel file of its homes, read and shown row by row, gate codes included, before anything is saved.

videos.title: Appointing an HOA Administrator
videos.about: A property manager invites someone to run the day to day, choosing from only the roles they're allowed to give.

videos.title: Paying your dues, on a phone
videos.about: The same payment as video 01, on a phone: the pay box fits the screen and the numbers are easy to type.

videos.title: Two homes, one account
videos.about: Casey owns two homes. Every alert says which home it's about, and switching between them is one click, with a clear note of which home is open.

videos.title: Taking payments: what the board sets up
videos.about: Where the board sees whether the community can take payments through NMI yet, what homeowners will see, and the next step: publishing a dues schedule.

videos.title: Every payment, and its confirmation number
videos.about: In Financials, every online payment carries the NMI confirmation number the homeowner was given and where it stands: paid, still clearing, or refunded.

videos.title: A maintenance request, from start to finish
videos.about: Sam reports a problem, the property manager assigns it, the vendor does the work, and Sam sees each step as it happens.

videos.title: A violation, from notice to lien
videos.about: How a violation moves: Avery issues a notice, Sam appeals, and each step after it (the re-inspection, the fine, the formal notice) is recorded, up to the review before a lien.

videos.title: What an HOA Administrator can and can't do
videos.about: The HOA Administrator runs the day to day with no board authority and no money: no financials in the menu, and the ledger politely says no.

videos.title: Archiving a home, with a reason
videos.about: A home can't be archived without saying why; it stays on record, and its history shows who archived it, when and why.

videos.title: Paying your dues: what else can happen
videos.about: What else can happen when Sam pays: a declined card, a change of mind, paying the whole balance, a community not yet taking payments online, and what Taylor, his tenant, sees.

videos.title: Setting up AutoPay: what else can happen
videos.about: What else Sam can do with AutoPay: turn it on straight from the switch, pause and resume it, what the due date brings when the charge goes through and when it doesn't, and canceling with a second chance.

videos.title: Your gate and guest codes: what else can happen
videos.about: What happens when Sam's home has no code yet, how the board answers his request, and how the tenant sees the same codes.

videos.title: Setting a home's gate codes: what else can happen
videos.about: What happens when a code is mistyped or removed, where a home's first codes came from, and why the secretary can only look.

videos.title: Your activity, and your home's timeline: what else can happen
videos.about: Who else sees a home's history: HOAhx support acting for Sam is marked plainly, a new tenant starts empty and never sees Sam's money, and staff see only what their role allows.

videos.title: The month, checked against NMI: what else can happen
videos.about: The month's report when things don't line up: a payment NMI never reported, checks and cash, a refund issued a month later, and an empty month the president reads too.

videos.title: Closing the month: what else can happen
videos.about: A month where everything agrees, closed by the president instead of the treasurer, and proof that a closed month still takes a new charge.

videos.title: A refund takes two people: what else can happen
videos.about: The other ways a refund goes: a void before settlement, a check refunded on the ledger, a request refused because it's the treasurer's own payment, a rejection with a note, and a completed refund's full record.

videos.title: The complete history: what else can happen
videos.about: Who reads the community's record: the outside auditor sees only the money, the secretary everything but, a backwards date range is refused, and a homeowner is turned away.

videos.title: Bringing a community in, from a spreadsheet: what else can happen
videos.about: What Morgan sees when a spreadsheet has mistakes in it: each bad row explained, skipped at setup, invitations held back, and the new community in the portfolio.

videos.title: Appointing an HOA Administrator: what else can happen
videos.about: What happens to an invitation after it's sent: tracked, resent or revoked, running out, accepted by the new administrator, and who else may appoint one.

videos.title: Two homes, one account: what else can happen
videos.about: Casey's alerts and balances stay with the home they belong to, and someone with one home, like Sam, sees no labels at all.

videos.title: Taking payments: what else can happen
videos.about: The rest of the board's Payments tab: a community with no merchant account yet, the last step of publishing the dues schedule that turns payments on, and the property manager seeing the same status.

videos.title: A maintenance request, from start to finish: what else can happen
videos.about: An urgent request with a photo, a message to the homeowner beside a note only staff see, what the repair company sees and doesn't, and closing a finished job.

videos.title: What an HOA Administrator can and can't do: what else can happen
videos.about: Where the HOA Administrator's job ends: she invites residents only, can't retire an account, can't set a fine or escalate, and can't change who may do what.
